phrases.chinese: 我是莫森小学一年级中文二班的Emma
phrases.pinyin: wǒ shì mò sēn xiǎo xué yī nián jí zhōng wén èr bān de Emma
phrases.sandhi: wǒ shì mò sēn xiǎo xué yì nián jí zhōng wén èr bān de Emma
phrases.english: I am Emma from Chinese Class 2, Grade 1 at Mawson Primary School.
I am seven years old this year.

phrases.pinyin: wǒ xǐ huān huà huà hé yóu yǒng
phrases.sandhi: wó xǐ huān huà huà hé yóu yǒng

phrases.chinese: 我最喜欢的颜色是绿色。
phrases.pinyin: wǒ zuì xǐ huān de yán sè shì lǜ sè
phrases.sandhi: wǒ zuì xǐ huān de yán sè shì lǜ sè

phrases.chinese: 今天我要和大家说说表妹。
phrases.pinyin: jīn tiān wǒ yào hé dà jiā shuō shuō biǎo mèi
phrases.sandhi: jīn tiān wǒ yào hé dà jiā shuō shuō biǎo mèi
phrases.english: Today I want to talk to everyone about my younger cousin.

phrases.pinyin: wǒ de biǎo mèi jiào Goldie.
phrases.sandhi: wǒ de biǎo mèi jiào Goldie.
phrases.english: My younger cousin is named Goldie.

phrases.chinese: 她有矮矮的个子，也有长长的棕色的头发。
phrases.pinyin: tā yǒu ǎi ǎi de gè zi, yě yǒu cháng cháng de zōng sè de tóu fa.
phrases.sandhi: tā yóu ái ǎi de gè zi, yé yǒu cháng cháng de zōng sè de tóu fa.
phrases.english: She is short, and also has long brown hair.

phrases.chinese: 她还有小小的鼻子和小小的嘴巴。
phrases.pinyin: tā hái yǒu xiǎo xiǎo de bí zi hé xiǎo xiǎo de zuǐ ba.
phrases.sandhi: tā hái yǒu xiáo xiǎo de bí zi hé xiáo xiǎo de zuǐ ba.
phrases.english: She also has a small nose and a small mouth.

phrases.chinese: 她喜欢去游乐场玩，不喜欢吃包子。
phrases.pinyin: tā xǐ huān qù yóu lè chǎng wán, bù xǐ huān chī bāo zi.
phrases.sandhi: tā xǐ huān qù yóu lè chǎng wán, bù xǐ huān chī bāo zi.
phrases.english: She likes to play at the amusement park, but doesn't like to eat steamed buns.

phrases.pinyin: wǒ de biǎo mèi hěn ài wǒ.
phrases.sandhi: wǒ de biǎo mèi hěn ài wǒ.
phrases.english: My younger cousin loves me very much.
